comment: Packaged fallback DOM contract. Verified live 2026-05-29; sectionLabel and the locale-independent hooks (toolbar button ids, hex/RGB input classes) re-verified live 2026-08-15; the border and table pickers captured live 2026-08-30; the Sheets data-validation dropdown-chip picker captured live 2026-09-01 (see docs/SPEC.md). Slides table cells reuse the slides fill/border buttons, so they need no row of their own. A picker whose widget differs from the shared one carries an `overrides` block; dom-contract resolves the variant from whichever entry point is visible. Every selector here must be locale-independent - an English aria-label breaks non-English UIs. The remote copy at /config/selectors supersedes this when reachable. dom-contract.js is the ONLY consumer.

dataValidationChip.comment: The dropdown-chip colour picker in the Data validation side panel (Data > Data validation > Dropdown > an option's colour chip). A DIFFERENT Closure widget from the toolbar pickers: it reuses docs-material-colorpalette markup (so injection is the shared path) but its custom-colour flow is its own. No toolbarButton: it is opened from a side-panel chip, so the monitor cannot drive it. Captured live 2026-09-01, bd workspace-custom-palette-gb3.
